G197/Pune-Lonavala/LC 36A – Malvali Vlg/20E] भवनेि कमार ग प्ता , म ख्य प्र िासजनक अजधकारी (जनमािण) MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS (Central Railway) NOTIFICATION Mumbai, the 12th May, 2026 Under clause 20E of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 S.O. 2538(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (Railway Board), number, S.O.706 (E) dated the 10th February 2026 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 11th February 2026 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification) and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) and Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management -- 3 of 5 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Construction of 2 lane ROB & LHS in lieu of LC gate no. 36A, in Village-Malvali, Tal-Maval, District-Pune of Pune-Lonavala section” in the State of Maharashtra. And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers “Janpravas (Marathi)” on 2nd March 2026, and “Bharat Dayari (Hindi)” on 28th February 2026 by Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition, No.13, Pune, District- Pune, Maharashtra, under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act. And whereas, no objections has been received. And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its report to the Central Government. Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.
